## Summary

Describe the user-facing outcome and why this change is needed.

## Verification

List the commands, tests, screenshots, or recordings used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one coherent outcome.
- [ ] Public API changes include TSDoc and usage examples.
- [ ] Component changes keep source, Registry, preview, API docs, and i18n aligned.
- [ ] Generated Registry or API documentation files were refreshed when needed.
- [ ] `pnpm run ci` passes locally, or any unavailable check is explained.
- [ ] User-facing changes are recorded under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
